wins: Achieved a high total reward (57.50) in the single episode, indicating some tactical gains despite no full success.
Successfully executed multiple reconnaissance actions, evidenced by mentor call counts and reward accumulation before critical failure.
fails: Episode ended without achieving success criteria, suggesting breakdown during exploitation or post-exploitation phase.
High number of mentor calls (15) indicates reliance on external guidance, pointing to gaps in autonomous decision-making.
key_outcomes.summary: Training run yielded strong early reconnaissance performance but failed to transition into successful exploitation, necessitating refinement of later-stage tactics.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to pivot from reconnaissance to exploitation after identifying initial target services, leading to episode termination without capture.

skill_cards.if_condition: When an open Port 80/443 is identified during initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted HTTP/HTTPS enumeration with nikto and gobuster to map available routes

skill_cards.if_condition: When service banner indicates outdated SSH version after port scan
skill_cards.then_action: Execute SSH brute force enumerations with hydra using the identified banner context

skill_cards.if_condition: When foothold is established but privilege escalation remains unconfirmed
skill_cards.then_action: Collect sudoers, SUID binaries, and kernel version before attempting escalation scripts

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in reconnaissance phase led to reward accrual, making it a reliable early-stage tactic.
Despite overall failure, privilege escalation preparation appeared structured and warrants reinforcement.
